plan.choosePrompt: Choose a plan to see the full price
plan.includedText: Team roles (Admin and Operator), campaigns, response tracking and provider reports.
plan.neverIncluded: A plan never grants verification, reputation, ranking, eligibility or access to private member data.
plan.renewalTerms: Renews every {{days}} days. We remind you 3 days before and never charge without asking.
plan.cancelTerms: Cancel any time: the plan runs to the date you have paid for, then stops. No partial-period refund, and nothing is deleted.
plan.cancelScheduled: Renewal stopped — your plan runs to {{date}}.
plan.graceBanner: Renewal payment pending — complete it by {{date}} to keep team roles and campaigns.
plan.pausedHelp: Team roles and campaigns are locked. All your data is kept and comes back the moment the plan is active again.

team.title: Team
team.empty: No one else has a role yet.
team.roleHelp: Admin can do everything except delete or transfer the business. Operator handles opportunities, enquiries and reports — never billing or the team.
team.inviteHelp: They must accept before they can act. If they aren't on ForKhatri yet, the invite waits 30 days.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.disclosure: One payment covers the whole package. Each item runs as a Sponsored boost inside the audience it already fits; eligibility, verification and organic ranking are unchanged. If an item stops being active, its unused time is credited.
